text:
I wrote the review to `queue-top/review.md` with verdict: pass. The diff only renames "All sessions" to "Sessions" in five label or comment spots, and I found nothing broken in it. I didn't open the screenshots or check the pages in a browser.

There was no `requirements.md` in the `queue-top` folder, so I judged against the card title ("Queue: the top priority-1 session-page fixes") and the diff. The review notes this as a finding.

The `session.jsonl` log has three empty-space warnings on `/framework/ai/`, `/framework/ai/AISession/` and `/framework/ai/sessions/v/mobile/`. The diff changes no layout, so I judged this change didn't cause them.

I also noted that the trail comment at `AISessionsPage.js:119` now says "Sessions / 2026 / ...", but I found no code there that draws an "All" root label.
